title: ResearchOS Whole-File Append-Only Anchor
description: PRP-002 rev3 (C2/A1). One entry pins the tip of one state/*.jsonl ledger: head_sha256 is the rolling hash of the first `lines` lines, so rewriting or deleting ANY anchored line (including the newest one) breaks the pin. prev_head_sha256/prev_lines chain the entries of one ledger; prev_anchor_head_sha256/prev_anchor_lines chain the anchor ledger itself, so rewriting an earlier anchor line breaks a later one. Entries are facts, never revised: a new tip is a new entry.
